How to help well

The most valuable contributions improve real compiler/runtime behavior and add regression evidence.

Tests matter

Reproduce first

Run the unittest suite and targeted CLI cases before and after a change.

No hidden framework swap

Keep the boundary visible

If a feature depends on Python, a browser API or a host SDK, document that boundary explicitly.

Cite inspected work

Research carefully

Record limitations, verify sources when possible, and do not present an idea as a project result.

Small parity gates

Prefer coherent slices

Migrate one compiler subsystem at a time and retain the bootstrap oracle until acceptance criteria pass.
